planning.direction: God question, Gorgon’s plain no, Alden’s held uncertainty, final raised restraint. Extraordinary memory impressions are subjective, not new confirmed powers.

planning.audioPaging: Each voiced entry has two or three reviewed chunks and is one page.

continuation.end: Gorgon’s gaze overwhelms Alden with profound memories. Hours later he wakes in recovery position with his hand wrapped, Victor eating tuna nearby. Before dawn he asks whether Gorgon is a god; Gorgon says no, checks his wellbeing, and shows the restraint that prevents an explanation. No renewed blood offer or consumption yet.
continuation.nextStart: “Well, did you taste some of my blood at least?”
continuation.note: Alden renews the offer, hears Gorgon’s warning about friendship and side effects, and considers his changed trust. Stop before explicit renewed permission.
